english.meaning: it is said that; apparently, going by what one has heard
english.note: Can come at the end of a sentence, as in 俾人哋壓價囖聽聞.

exampleSentences.english: Muk found a job, but I hear they lowballed him.
exampleSentences.traditional: 阿木佢揾到工，不過呢就俾人哋壓價囖聽聞。
